en-US:
Release candidate for the App Store (0.7.3).
• New: scan a paper receipt with the camera, or attach a photo, file or PDF with the new Camera and Attach buttons beside Smart Entry; reminders you set up yourself (Settings › Reminders: ahead of scheduled payments and income, up to three daily times, a weekly review, snooze and a test); a Focus filter that hides amounts (Settings › Focus › choose one › Add Filter › MoneyUp); Home Screen quick actions (touch and hold the icon); History search across every date, with touch-and-hold preview.
• After auto-lock, a widget, Control Center or Siri opens Log without unlocking. The other tabs still ask.
• Quicker: your book opens almost instantly after unlock, and restore and export are much faster.
• After updating from 0.7.2, MoneyUp upgrades how your book is encrypted, once, in the background.
Please check: after updating from 0.7.2, all your entries, budgets and accounts are still there; scan a receipt and attach a PDF; set up a reminder and send a test; log from a widget after auto-lock.
zh-Hans:
App Store 候选版本（0.7.3）。
• 新增：用相机扫描纸质收据，或用智能记账旁新的“相机”和“附件”按钮附加照片、文件和 PDF；由你自己设置的提醒（设置 › 提醒：计划收支提前提醒、每天最多三次、每周回顾、稍后提醒和测试提醒）；在专注模式中隐藏金额（设置 › 专注模式 › 选择一个 › 添加过滤器 › MoneyUp）；主屏幕快捷操作（按住图标）；明细搜索所有日期，并可按住预览。
• 自动锁定后，小组件、控制中心和 Siri 可直接打开记账页，无需解锁；其他标签页仍需解锁。
• 更快：解锁后账本几乎即时打开，恢复和导出大幅加快。
• 从 0.7.2 更新后，MoneyUp 会在后台一次性升级账本的加密方式。
请检查：从 0.7.2 更新后，所有交易、预算和账户是否完整；扫描一张收据并附加一个 PDF；设置一个提醒并发送测试提醒；自动锁定后从小组件记一笔。
